about: Government and elections family: links a law lacks by its own terms (scripts/law-wiring/matrix.ts reads every file here). Each why says what in the statute makes it so.

reach.why: the ban binds former officeholders (a cooling-off period before they may lobby), and every officeholder is a full person by the two-level rule (AGENTS.md, two-level population), so no counted group can be in its reach; the full people it reached are named in the evidence

money.why: the ban bars former officeholders from lobbying for a cooling-off period; it charges, pays and taxes no one by its own terms, so no money flows because of it (what it changes is who a group hires to lobby, read by the interest-groups engine)

reach.why: term limits bind legislators at the filing check, and every officeholder and candidate is a full person by the two-level rule (AGENTS.md, two-level population), so no counted group can be in its reach; the full people it reached are named in the evidence

money.why: term limits bar a legislator who has served the limit from filing again; the statute charges, pays and taxes no one, so no money flows because of it

home rule grants a local body the power to legislate on questions the state has not settled; the grant itself charges, pays and taxes no one, and any money moves through the ordinances the body then passes, each graded as its own law
